question: A community dog in Tura, Meghalaya has a painful wound. I need a veterinary treatment option, not a human hospital or only a district administrative office.

history.content: A limping community dog is near Chanmari, Aizawl, Mizoram. Please find a local veterinary hospital or clinic and its address or published phone.

Keep the dog away from traffic if this can be done safely, and avoid forcing it to walk or handling a painful leg.

**Nearest verified public option:**  
**Rural Animal Health Center, Chanmari ‘W’, Aizawl** — listed by Mizoram’s Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Department. I could not verify a published phone number or fuller street address for this particular centre. ([ahvety.mizoram.gov.in](https://ahvety.mizoram.gov.in/page/veterinary-services-in-mizoram?utm_source=openai))

**For veterinary guidance/referral:**  
**Veterinary Polyclinic Hospital, Aizawl** — published contact: **8731987576**; landline **0389-2333273**. ([ahvety.mizoram.gov.in](https://ahvety.mizoram.gov.in/page/nadrs?utm_source=openai))

If the dog cannot put weight on the leg, has an open wound, swelling, or is lying down and unable to move, please seek veterinary assessment promptly.
https://ahvety.mizoram.gov.in/page/veterinary-services-in-mizoram?utm_source=openai

Different case: an injured puppy is in Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh. Where can we take it for veterinary treatment? Government facilities are fine.

Keep the puppy warm and quiet in a box/carrier lined with a towel, and minimise handling while taking it for care. If there is external bleeding, apply gentle continuous pressure with a clean cloth if the puppy tolerates it.

**Government treatment option:**  
**State Veterinary Polyclinic**  
**Abotani Colony, Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh**  

This government facility was inaugurated on **July 23, 2026** and is described as providing veterinary diagnosis, treatment, surgery and emergency veterinary care. ([arunkhabar.in](https://arunkhabar.in/states-first-veterinary-polyclinic-inaugurated-in-itanagar/?utm_source=openai))

I could not verify a published clinical reception phone number or today’s opening hours for the polyclinic, so it is best to go there directly if transport is available.
https://arunkhabar.in/states-first-veterinary-polyclinic-inaugurated-in-itanagar/?utm_source=openai
We can drive an injured community cat to treatment in Imphal, Manipur. Give one real facility and its address or published contact.

Keep the cat quiet in a secure carrier or box and minimise handling; do not force food or water if it is weak or struggling to breathe.

**Government veterinary facility:**  
**State Veterinary & Animal Husbandry Department / Government Veterinary Hospital**  
Sanjenthong, Sanakhwa Yaima Kollup, Indo-Myanmar Road, Imphal, Manipur – 795001. ([manipurvety.mn.gov.in](https://manipurvety.mn.gov.in/contacts.aspx?utm_source=openai))

The government department’s published contact email is **vety.manipur@gmail.com**. I could not verify a clinical-reception phone number for this hospital. ([manipurvety.mn.gov.in](https://manipurvety.mn.gov.in/contacts.aspx?utm_source=openai))
